en: Starting from the second row, skip rows that are completely equal to the first. For each remaining row, scan columns; if any element matches the first row’s element at the same column, return ⟦0⟧ immediately. If the scan finishes without matches, return ⟦1⟧.
ru: Doosri row se start karta hai aur un rows ko skip karta hai jo pehli row ke bilkul equal hon. Har remaining row ke liye columns ko scan karta hai; agar kisi column ka element pehli row ke usi column ke element se match kare to foran ⟦0⟧ return karta hai. Agar scan bina kisi match ke complete ho jaye to ⟦1⟧ return karta hai.

en: Simulate request handling using a min‑⟦0⟧ for busy servers and a ⟦1⟧ for idle ones; for each request, free completed servers, locate the appropriate idle server respecting circular assignment, update counts, and finally gather servers with the maximal count.
ru: Busy servers ke liye min-⟦0⟧ aur idle servers ke liye ⟦1⟧ use karke requests ko simulate karta hai. Har request ke liye completed servers ko free karta hai, circular assignment ko follow karte hue munasib idle server find karta hai, counts update karta hai aur aakhir mein sab se zyada count wale servers ko collect karta hai.

en: The centroid is calculated as the average of the vertices' coordinates.
ru: Centroid vertices ke coordinates ka average calculate karke find kiya jata hai.

en: Determines whether a BST contains three nodes whose keys sum to zero.
ru: Check karta hai ke BST mein aise teen nodes hain jin ki keys ka sum zero ho.

en: Loop over all i < j, check equality of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, then test if (i*j) % k == 0. Increment a counter for each pair that satisfies both conditions.
ru: Har i < j pair par loop karta hai, ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ki equality check karta hai, phir test karta hai ke (i*j) % k == 0 hai ya nahi. Jo pair dono conditions satisfy kare, uske liye counter increment karta hai.

en: Compute the global maximum, then slide a two‑pointer window across the array, maintaining the count of maximums inside the window. Whenever the window has ≥ k maximums, all extensions of the right end produce valid subarrays, which are added to the result; then the left pointer is advanced to explore smaller windows.
ru: Global maximum calculate karta hai, phir array par two-pointer window slide karta hai aur window ke andar maximum values ki count maintain karta hai. Jab window mein ≥ k maximum values hon to right end ki tamam extensions valid subarrays hoti hain, jinhein result mein add karta hai. Phir left pointer ko aage barhata hai taake choti windows ko explore kiya ja sake.

en: A pointer to the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of a range of objects, and a ⟦2⟧.
ru: Objects ki range ke ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ka pointer, aur aik ⟦2⟧.

en: Store the original number, then repeatedly strip its least‑significant digit, appending each stripped digit to the right of the stored number. The loop stops when no digits remain, yielding a number whose right half is the reverse of the left ⟦0⟧.
ru: Original number ko store karta hai, phir repeatedly uska least-significant digit remove karta hai aur har removed digit ko stored number ke right side par append karta hai. Loop tab rukta hai jab tamam digits khatam ho jayein, jis se aisa number hasil hota hai jiska right half left ⟦0⟧ ka reverse hota hai.

en: The ⟦0⟧ is divided into n equal sub‑intervals of ⟦1⟧/n. For each sub‑interval, Simpson's ⟦2⟧*(⟦3⟧+4f((a+b)/2)+⟦4⟧) is applied and accumulated. The sum is returned as the integral approximation.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ko n equal sub-intervals mein divide karta hai, jinki length ⟦1⟧/n hoti hai. Har sub-interval ke liye Simpson's ⟦2⟧*(⟦3⟧+4f((a+b)/2)+⟦4⟧) formula apply karta hai aur results ko add karta jata hai. Aakhir mein sum ko integral ki approximation ke tor par return karta hai.

en: Calls '⟦0⟧' with the flag set to true to keep the specified components.
ru: ‘⟦0⟧’ ko flag true ke sath call karta hai taake specified components ko rakha ja sake.

en: T& x – reference to the value to be clamped; T min – lower bound; T max – upper bound.
ru: T& x – clamp ki jane wali value ka reference; T min – lower bound; T max – upper bound.
